post.summary: Resolve and diagnose a draft layout
post.description: Resolves every element property of an unsaved draft layout and reports what is structurally broken or still unresolved, without persisting and without rendering against a real entity. Returns the per-element `resolutions` plus a well-formedness / resolvability `diagnostics` report. The optional `entityType` or `section` binds the draft to a source's root context so binding-scope resolvability can be checked; with neither, only intrinsic well-formedness is evaluated. The whole request body is optional; an absent body diagnoses an empty tree. Requires the `content_layout:read` privilege. A malformed element config is reported as an `invalid_config` violation in the body at `200`, not as an error; only an `entityType` matching no source, an invalid/unregistered `section`, or a structurally malformed element is rejected with `400`.

boundToEntity.summary: Diagnose a draft bound to a product source

intrinsicOnly.summary: Diagnose well-formedness only, no source bound

200.description: The per-element resolutions plus the well-formedness / resolvability report. Never persisted, never cached.
